Telephone PIN wires over $250,000 (non-repetitive) require a second PIN holder's confirmation by bank call-back.

exceptions.bank_handling: 'Bank will not release any affected payment until such time as Bank receives any necessary confirmation that Bank seeks'; monitoring is explicitly not part of the Security Procedures

exceptions.trigger: Manual (email/in-person) wire request fails call-back or out-of-wallet confirmation
exceptions.customer_experience: Order 'deemed to have been canceled prior to acceptance by Bank'; if signer/authority does not match, bank calls an Authorized Agent and requests a new Outgoing Wire Transfer Request Agreement
exceptions.bank_handling: Signature/authority verification against the Outgoing Wire Agreement, then call-back to a secondary individual and/or in-/out-of-wallet questions
exceptions.resolution: Resubmit via recommended channel (FTD) or new signed agreement; Dual Control Security Waiver required to proceed without recommended procedures
